title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_unfreeze}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 C2 — operator lifts a poison-pattern freeze on a DLQ topic. The supervisor drops the topic from its frozen set and resets the per-topic poison-window log so the next burst starts fresh. Idempotent: ack accepted=true even when the topic was not frozen (mirrors §8.13.5 idempotency posture).

target.description: DLQ topic to unfreeze (must end in '.dlq').
